title: Dialogue-first synthesis with bounded artifact batches
description: Keeps literature synthesis transparent and conversational while writing evidence objects and reports in bounded semantic batches; speed is secondary to keeping the user informed.
changes: Present a provisional evidence-backed direction map after the first coherent seed batch.
Preview long retrieval, synthesis, and artifact operations with their objective, reason, and expected result.
Emit a chat checkpoint whenever a completed evidence batch changes the research judgment.
Report rate-limit retries, weak evidence, plan changes, and real blockers instead of emitting fixed heartbeats.
Communicate conclusions before writing large artifacts.
Write at most five PaperCard records per tool call and group records by semantic family.
Keep conclusions in chat, execution details in process, and complete content in artifacts.

rollback.notes: Restore artifact visibility rules without dialogue checkpoints or bounded writes.
